dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Not bad, Kachina! Even if we weren't friends, I'd have given your dessert 8.5 outta 10!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #I'll leave half a point for myself, which I'll give you once you've gotten even better at this... and the last point will be {NICKNAME}'s to hand out.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I... I'd have only given myself a 6.5, really.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: And now that I've thought about how I baked the cake... I think I know what's missing. I'll do better next time!
